title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-50010)
description: CVE-2026-50010 is a high-severity security vulnerability affecting the wso2am package, which uses Netty, a network application framework for protocol servers and clients. The vulnerability impacts versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in these versions.
